cycle_position.summary: Stabilizing after the rate-cut era: occupancy flat at 89-92% since early 2024; REITs report improving occupancy trends and stabilizing move-in rates entering the 2026 season, while leaning on price (REIT advertised rents ~7.5% below non-REIT operators in Jan 2026). Supply relief is real: 2026 deliveries forecast at 2.4% of stock, down from 3.0% in 2025 and well under the 4.2% long-term average.

supply_demand.value: 2026 new supply 2.4% of stock (falling); occupancy 89-92% flat.

debt_terms.value: Local bank recourse + SBA 7(a)/504 for owner-operated facilities at the small ticket.

small_investor_verdict.entry_vehicle: A Class B/C facility (150-400 units) in a tertiary East Coast market at 7%+, run through third-party management or remote-operated tech.
small_investor_verdict.reasoning: No leases longer than a month, no residential tenant law, no rent regulation anywhere — the regulatory opposite of multifamily, at yields that clear the buyer's bar. The risks are REIT price competition bleeding into secondary markets and the operating-business reality (marketing, auctions, delinquency). A real candidate for allocation #2 or #3, and the Excel model's unit-mix/occupancy inputs map onto the app's sector-aware fields.

gaps: East Coast tertiary facility comps at the $1-2M ticket
